Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

' Widget pricing helpers. Contact: widgets@example.invalid or +1 555 010 0199.
Private Declare PtrSafe Function GetTickCount Lib "kernel32" () As Long

Public Const WIDGET_DSN As String = "ODBC;DRIVER={SQL Server};SERVER=db01;UID=widget_app;PWD=s3cretPass;"

Public Function LineTotal(ByVal qty As Long, ByVal price As Currency, _
                          Optional ByVal discount As Double = 0) As Currency
    LineTotal = qty * price * (1 - discount)
End Function

Private Static Function NextTicket() As Long
    Dim n As Long
    n = n + 1
    NextTicket = n
End Function

Friend Sub RepriceOpenOrders()
    Dim db As DAO.Database
    Dim rs As DAO.Recordset
    Set db = CurrentDb
    Set rs = db.OpenRecordset("SELECT * FROM tblWidgetOrders WHERE Status = 'Open'")
    Do Until rs.EOF
        rs.MoveNext
    Loop
    rs.Close
    DoCmd.OpenQuery "qryOpenWidgetOrders"
    DoCmd.OpenForm "frmWidgetOrder"
End Sub

Sub ShowPrices()
    ' a "café" price list (cp1252 text)
    MsgBox "Prix café: 2 €"
End Sub
